name: _linalg_check_errors
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::_linalg_check_errors(Tensor info, str api_name, *, bool is_matrix) -> (). Registered schemas (all supplied, verbatim): aten::_linalg_check_errors(Tensor info, str api_name, *, bool is_matrix) -> (). This definition represents only that one overload; the original Gems pytest owns the full contract - overloads, keyword arguments, return behaviour, raised errors, aliasing and mutation - and no test may be removed or its reference behaviour adapted to fit this single signature. Semantics: the operator reads an int32 factorization-status tensor; it returns nothing (Python None) and stays silent when every status code is zero, and otherwise reports the first non-zero code it finds by raising against api_name, whose value is observable through the message wording; for torch.linalg.inv, torch.linalg.cholesky and torch.linalg.solve the exception class differs from the class used for torch.linalg.lu_factor or an unrecognized name, and the tested names also include torch.linalg.qr and an empty name. The keyword-only is_matrix flag selects the single-status-code interpretation (no batch position in the message) when true and the batched scan otherwise; the info tensor is read-only and is never modified. Non-int32 dtypes, non-contiguous info, non-tensor info, non-str api_name, omitted api_name and positional/omitted is_matrix are rejected natively; for is_matrix, values the schema coerces to bool (numbers, None, 0-dim bool tensors) are accepted, while a string, bytes, a sequence or an arbitrary object is rejected. Those error paths stay in the pytest.
